폰, 아이패드, 맥북에 다 깔아놨는데 습관 완료 체크는 동기화가 즉각적으로 되지만 습관 하나를 추가하거나 루틴에서 습관을 더하고 빼거나 옮기거나 하는 등의 액션을 하면 앱이 좀 꼬이는 것 같아요 심지어 당일 아니면 습관 수정도 못하게 해놨어서 너무 불편함.

reviews.title: Love the idea, buggy execution
reviews.text:
I love the app and how you can start a timer for each task. It really helps me stay focused and get things done.

However, the app is quite buggy. I’ve created multiple routines depending on my schedule. For context, I’m a medical student, so some days I study all day, while other days I have clinical rotations and then study afterward.

Even though the app allows you to switch between routines, it doesn’t stay on the selected one. When I reopen the app later in the day, it switches back to a default routine, even if I already completed tasks from that morning from a different routine. 

There are just too many bugs right now for me to rely on the app daily. I really wanted to purchase the lifetime membership, but it’s too buggy at the moment :( 

옥민송 대표님, 개발자님, 마이루틴 어플 너무 좋은데 버그 많아서 사용하기 불편해요 ㅠㅠ 위에 적은 것 말고도 루틴 타이머 시작하면 중간에 그만하기 눌러도 나중에 들어가보면 계속 켜져있고요.. 여기에 다 적기 어려울만큼 버그 넘 많아요.. 버그 좀 고쳐주세요 ㅜㅡㅜ

reviews.title: Amazing design - buggy features.
reviews.text: I thought I wasn’t going to be able to use this app based on all the glitches I was experiencing (time of day tags and goal tags keep getting messed or deleted by the system seemingly randomly - which very much limits your ability to use widgets), but I found a fix. All the bugs are happening on routine’s specifically, not just simple habits - so I switched all my tasks back to individual habits and the app is now working fine. That work around is not the cleaniest, but it does work fine for my purposes! Live widget also has some mad bugs - and I had to go in and disable it. Developers - please take a look at the bugs in the live widget and routine features!  (but especially the widget - I can live without the routine but the live widget is designed so nice, I want it!!) Otherwise, beautifully designed app - it’s clear so much intention / research was put into the development of this tool.

reviews.title: Download it!
reviews.text: Life changing! I originally downloaded this app to build habits. Checking each habit I’ve completed feels so satisfying. It’s that small sense of pride that keeps you going. No matter how small that change seems, when you incorporate into your everyday life, it makes a difference. This app gives me an excuse to not skip out on small tasks from flossing to getting ahead of my assignments. The functions could be a bit smoother and the emoji keyboard has a small scrolling back-and-forth bug, but this app still does its job and completes its purpose well. The thing I love most about this app is how you can build a series of routines and have a timer for each of them. If you take too long, then the timer will turn red and begin to count your overtime. That has shown me when I surprisingly take too long on something that I didn’t think was a problem. Best of all, you have the option to make habits repeat between certain weekdays or a number of times a week, and if you do finish something that was a goal, you can mark it off forever. For example, when I got my braces off today, I could mark my habit of wearing elastics as forever completed. :) Something this app could change is seeing progress as “last 7 days” or “last 30 days” instead of “this week” or “this month”. Because when you just started a month, there’s not much to see with “this month,” and that forces me to scroll back to see my progress from last month, which is less efficient.

reviews.title: the app i’ve always wanted
reviews.text:
I’ve tried more than a few routine-building apps and this is by far the one closest to what I’ve always wanted in one of these. First of all— NO TIMER (or at least the option to turn it off.) Timers have always been a source of stress in my routines because I can’t always stick to whatever I’ve assigned a habit. Secondly— the LOOK! I’m a spreadsheet girl, plain and simple as that. The customization is always fun too. And finally— the routines themselves! I love that I can easily make weekly and daily habits and toggle between having them on specific days or just up to a certain # of times in a given time range.
My only gripe is that the app doesn’t keep my appearance preference (dark mode) when I access the app via a widget. I’m sure it’ll get addressed soon enough.
Anyway, this is well worth my money :) (written about a week into using it)
